items.label: Technicians
items.note: You will see the same one

items.a: No. Northmark Heating & Air is invented. This build is a demonstration of a design family, published so the design can be shown without linking a real client's site or a prospect's private pitch.

items.q: Do you size from the old equipment?
items.a: No. We run a room-by-room load calculation. Copying the old label is how a building ends up with the wrong system twice.

items.q: What do I get at the end of an installation?
items.a: The commissioning figures — load, charge, airflow and static pressure — alongside the invoice.

items.q: My system runs constantly. Is it broken?
items.a: Possibly not. Constant running is often a duct or sizing problem rather than a fault. Diagnostics will tell you which.
